description: This file defines an Express.js router for managing LLMCost records via CRUD endpoints. It includes middleware for authentication, tenant enforcement, tenant scope resolution, and detailed request handling for multi-tenant considerations. The router exposes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting LLMCost documents, with extensive support for tenant resolution via headers, query parameters, and special admin bypass logic.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list LLMCost records with support for tenant scope, sorting, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific LLMCost record by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLMCost record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLMCost record by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an LLMCost record by ID.
